gaps.sentence: Millions suffer ___ hay fever every summer.
Several parents objected ___ the new timetable.
The kids are crazy ___ the new video game.
gaps.explanation: crazy ABOUT something = love it enthusiastically.

gaps.sentence: Viewers were shocked ___ the violence in the film.
His attitude ___ work has really improved.
The high wall prevents outsiders ___ entering the garden.
gaps.explanation: prevent/stop somebody FROM doing something ('from' is optional after stop).

gaps.sentence: The novel was translated ___ twelve languages.
gaps.explanation: translate FROM one language INTO another.

gaps.sentence: I haven't heard ___ my cousin since Christmas.
gaps.explanation: hear FROM somebody = get a letter/message from them.
